name: cat_collector_only_the_first_life_gain_makes_cats
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a Food token. ... Whenever you gain life for the first time during each of your turns, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.' Two Cat Collectors enter on seat 0's turn: two Foods. Seat 0 sacrifices one Food (gains 3, its first life gain this turn: each Collector's trigger makes a Cat, two Cats, put on the stack in the order seat 0 picks, CR 603.3b), then the other (gains 3 again: no more Cats). Life 26, two Cats, no Food. (act:card:14:0 and act:card:15:0 are the two Foods, made after the two setup cards and the twelve library fillers.)
